I am privileged to lead a team of highly qualified Entomologists at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan. Our aim is to provide a friendly working environment to faculty and students for quality teaching and research in Entomology. This can be achieved only when we are accommodative, supportive and have respect for each other and this is what I expect from my team. Our team is highly skilled, professional and conduct research in the larger domain of Entomology and related subjects. The department welcomes researchers, current and prospective students to explore AWKUM web pages for further details about the programs, courses, admission process, potential supervisors, career opportunities and on-campus facilities. The Department has running research projects and is striving to achieve more funding through competitive and other research grants.

Dr. Farman Ali, Chairman Department of Entomology
